results.title: ElvUI for 12.0 [UPDATE: Official Release is here!] - Community / General Discussion - World of Warcraft Forums
excerpts:
We’re currently supporting **5** different versions of the game in our AddOn at the same time and we know people love sharing their profiles across Retail, Mists, TBC, Classic Era(+Hardcore) as well as Titan Reforged realms - and we want to keep it that way. It also means that all of the non-Retail versions will lose some of the features we have to remove due to Blizzards upcoming AddOn restrictions in Midnight. The support for non-Retail is still there but some features will be as basic as in Retail.

##  Heads Up

If any features mentioned in here are marked as “stable” or “working” it does not automatically mean it’s fully finished and bug-free. For now we’re focusing on a initial version of ElvUI for Midnight which will load and provide the core features for patch 12.0.

##  Development Status

As seen in ⁠elvui-changelog all of the 12.0 progress is done on the ptr GitHub branch and automatically gets packaged for download here: The current link is:  
`https://api.tukui.
org/v1/download/dev/elvui/main` \- there is no support for using this early version, use at own risk and don’t try to report issues.

**Update: They switched from the ptr branch to the main branch, link is updated, though the official release is aimed for tonight!**

##  Whats staying (even if very limited) and whats removed (and no longer possible) ?

The current status is as follows:

* Unitframes and Nameplates **will be very basic in terms of features, this is heavy WIP** (Style stays mostly the same)
* Tags (text formats) for Unitframes and Nameplates **will be very limited and only be able to display basic APIs**
* ElvUI skins for Blizzard panels (Character, Spellbook, Transmog, LFG, etc, etc) **stay the same** , most of them are Midnight ready!
* Core features such as Actionbars, Bags, Chat, DataBars, DataTexts **lost some features, but are mostly working**
* Cooldown text is being recoded into something very basic **this is work in progress and heavily restricted by Blizzard**
